description: Every filter, defined once. Values travel in the URL and the API under `param`. Filters that depend on optional source fields are switched on by the manufacturer config (`configFlag`) or by a data capability (`requires`).

filters.label: Snapshot
filters.notes: Every response states its snapshot; a screen never mixes snapshots.

filters.label: Risk band
filters.notes: Bands come from the model's versioned risk policy.

filters.label: Data state
filters.notes: Dormant operators are excluded from the default queue.

filters.label: Operator size
filters.notes: Size bands from 12-month revenue, method set in config.

filters.label: Product line
filters.values: Product lines in the manufacturer's hierarchy
filters.notes: On the queue: operators whose relationship with this line is flagged.

filters.label: Territory
filters.values: Sales territory codes from the claims source

filters.label: Owner or team
filters.values: Owners and teams from the ownership source
filters.default: me, when the signed-in user owns accounts; otherwise all

filters.label: Division
filters.notes: Shown only when the manufacturer has more than one division.

filters.label: Reporting distributor
filters.values: Distributors that reported claims in the last 3 months
filters.notes: Operators with claims via this distributor. A filter for context, not a prediction level.

filters.label: Find an operator
filters.values: Free text on operator name or ID
